body.purpose: Messages and the composer; DotGothic16 bitmap face, one weight, font-synthesis none. Measure bounded at 72ch on the text itself.

title.purpose: Blue title strips: paper, uppercase, .06-.08em tracking. What makes a column a window.

label.purpose: Group heads, day dividers, hints, sub-lines: silver, 10-11.5px, uppercase where sectional.

code.purpose: JetBrains Mono in bordered code windows on the void; also tabular figures (tnum). The one non-bitmap face, by named concession.

materials.name: bg-hover
materials.purpose: Row hover: an ordered violet-on-indigo dither. A texture, never a lightening.

materials.name: dither-half
materials.purpose: Half-density void checker: 'unavailable', and the pixel-breaker riding on the horizon band at 4px.

materials.name: backdrop
materials.purpose: The modal dim: dithering instead of alpha, the way a 1992 machine dimmed what it could not blend.

materials.name: band
materials.purpose: The horizon band, always paired with dither-half at 4px. Exactly three homes: titlebar bottom edge (3px), settings window bottom edge (4px), empty-state heading underline (4px x 96px).

shadows.name: shadow-bar
shadows.purpose: Floating toolbars, the settings card, the empty-state icon block.

shadows.name: chassis
shadows.purpose: The double-frame button chassis: dark outer line plus cast shadow; :active shortens to 2px and translates 1px,1px.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only curve; used solely on the primary button's 90ms press transform.

motion.name: snap-2
motion.purpose: State snaps: rail marker, speaking frame, switch color. Palette-swap motion, never a fade.

motion.name: snap-3
motion.purpose: The switch knob crossing its track.

motion.name: snap-8
motion.purpose: Progress fill advancing in cells (transform scaleX, never width).

motion.name: no-infinite
motion.purpose: Gaming wins: nothing repaints on the idle path; prefers-reduced-motion collapses all durations.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Channel column 200px, topic drops, self toggles slim to 24px.

breakpoints.name: members-drop
breakpoints.purpose: Member list dropped by setting state in the script (matchMedia), never a CSS override.

components.name: Join Button (primary)
components.description: The one solid magenta fill in the resting window: magenta in a paper frame set in a dark outer line. Hover brightens by dither; active presses in.
components.html: <button class="ds-join"><svg class="ds-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"><path d="M6 4.5h6.5v15H6zM12.5 9h5.5v6h-5.5z"/></svg>Join the call</button>
components.css: .ds-join { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 34px; padding: 0 18px; background: #D460A2; color: #070810; border: 2px solid #EFE9D5; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #070810, 3px 3px 0 #070810; font-family: 'DotGothic16', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 90ms cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1); } .ds-join:hover { background-image: repeating-conic-gradient(#EFE9D5 0% 25%, transparent 0% 100%); background-size: 4px 4px; } .ds-join:active { transform: translate(1px, 1px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #070810, 2px 2px 0 #070810; } .ds-join:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5FD3E0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-icon { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

components.name: Standard Button
components.description: The workhorse: space fill, steel border, paper text. Hover is a full inversion to paper.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 28px; padding: 0 11px; background: #070810; border: 1px solid #4A5490; border-radius: 0; color: #EFE9D5; font-family: 'DotGothic16', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 400; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #EFE9D5; border-color: #EFE9D5; color: #070810; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5FD3E0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Failure and leave actions only: coral outline on the void; hover fills coral.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; height: 30px; padding: 0 14px; background: #070810; color: #F0716B; border: 1px solid #F0716B; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'DotGothic16', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #F0716B; color: #070810; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5FD3E0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Channel Row
components.description: The menu-row grammar: silver at rest, dither on hover, full cell inversion when current; the count badge re-inverts on the inverted row.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 224px; background: #10122A; padding: 8px; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; background: none; border: 0; border-radius: 0; color: #A7AECC; font-family: 'DotGothic16', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row:hover { background: repeating-conic-gradient(#2E3464 0% 25%, #191D3A 25% 50%) 0 0 / 2px 2px; color: #EFE9D5; } .ds-row[aria-current="true"] { background: #EFE9D5; color: #070810; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5FD3E0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row-ico { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; color: #4A5490; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-ico { color: #A7AECC; } .ds-row[aria-current="true"] .ds-row-ico { color: #070810; } .ds-row-name { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge { min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 5px; background: #EFE9D5; color: #070810; font-size: 11px; line-height: 18px; text-align: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row[aria-current="true"] .ds-badge { background: #070810; color: #EFE9D5; }

components.name: Composer Input
components.description: A bordered input line from 1992: ink window in the double chassis, cyan caret, border lifts to cyan on focus.
components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 4px; width: 360px; padding: 6px 6px 6px 8px; border: 1px solid #4A5490; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #070810, 2px 2px 0 #070810; background: #10122A; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: #5FD3E0; } .ds-composer-ta { flex: 1; min-height: 26px; padding: 4px 4px 4px 2px; border: 0; background: none; resize: none; outline: none; color: #EFE9D5; font-family: 'DotGothic16', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; caret-color: #5FD3E0; } .ds-composer-ta::placeholder { color: #A7AECC; } .ds-composer-btn { width: 30px; height: 30px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: none; border: 0; color: #A7AECC; cursor: pointer; } .ds-composer-btn:hover { background: #EFE9D5; color: #070810; } .ds-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

components.name: Avatar Sprite + Presence
components.description: Identity as a sprite: filled square in the peer hue with a space-ink monogram; presence is a lit square notched into the corner. Offline is an unlit square, not a warning.
components.html: DRM
components.css: .ds-avrow { display: flex; gap: 14px; padding: 8px; background: #10122A; } .ds-avwrap { position: relative; display: inline-flex; } .ds-avatar { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #070810; font-family: 'DotGothic16', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; border-radius: 0; user-select: none; } .ds-av-1 { background: #8FB8F0; } .ds-av-2 { background: #C4DC78; } .ds-av-3 { background: #E08A48; } .ds-dot { position: absolute; right: -2px; bottom: -2px; width: 9px; height: 9px; border: 2px solid #10122A; box-sizing: content-box; } .ds-dot-online { background: #62CE82; } .ds-dot-dnd { background: #D460A2; } .ds-dot-offline { background: #10122A; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #4A5490; }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: A square switch whose knob steps across the track — steps(3), never a slide-and-ease; on is cyan ground with a space knob.
components.html: <button class="ds-switch" role="switch" aria-checked="true" aria-label="Setting"></button> <button class="ds-switch" role="switch" aria-checked="false" aria-label="Setting off"></button>
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 38px; height: 22px; background: #070810; border: 1px solid #4A5490; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 16px; height: 16px; background: #A7AECC; transition: transform 120ms steps(3, jump-end), background 120ms steps(2, jump-end); } .ds-switch[aria-checked="true"] { background: #5FD3E0; border-color: #5FD3E0; } .ds-switch[aria-checked="true"]::after { transform: translateX(16px); background: #070810; } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5FD3E0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Accent Chip
components.description: Cyan-owned chips (update available, watching a share): outlined on the void, hover inverts into the accent.
components.html: <button class="ds-chip"><svg class="ds-chip-ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="square"><path d="M12 3.5v11M7.5 10.5 12 15l4.5-4.5M4.5 19.5h15"/></svg>Update 1.0.2</button>
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 19px; padding: 0 8px; background: #070810; border: 1px solid #5FD3E0; border-radius: 0; color: #5FD3E0; font-family: 'DotGothic16', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #5FD3E0; color: #070810; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5FD3E0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-ico { width: 12px; height: 12px; }

components.name: Titled Window
components.description: The signature container: blue title strip with paper uppercase text, 1px space under-edge, violet border, horizon band on the bottom edge, hard shadow when floating.
components.html:
Channels

Every zone is a window because it wears this strip. Text is paper; the quiet tier is silver.
components.css: .ds-window { width: 300px; background: #10122A; border: 1px solid #2E3464; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #070810; } .ds-window-title { margin: 0; padding: 10px 14px; background: #3B58C4; border-bottom: 1px solid #070810; color: #EFE9D5; font-family: 'DotGothic16', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-window-body { padding: 14px; color: #A7AECC; font-family: 'DotGothic16', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-window::after { content: ""; display: block; height: 4px; background: repeating-conic-gradient(#070810 0% 25%, transparent 25% 50%) 0 0 / 4px 4px, linear-gradient(90deg, #191D3A 0 18%, #2E3464 0 34%, #3B58C4 0 50%, #D460A2 0 66%, #E08A48 0 84%, #E7BC5D 0 100%); }

narrative.overview:
FitCommunication is drawn as a Japanese sixteen-color PC screen of the early nineties (PC-98 lineage, seed key c9bbaaa4, 2026-08-12): a locked sixteen-color palette on deep indigo, paper text, blue title strips on square double-bordered windows, and a machine that answers instantly — state changes snap like a palette swap, nothing fades, nothing pulses. This world replaced 'The Well-Made Standard' wholesale; design/main-window.html and design/shots/ document the replaced world and are anti-reference for this one.

The material logic is the pixel grid. There is no translucency, no blur, no gradient blend anywhere in the resting system: every mid-tone is an ordered 2px dither of exactly two palette colors, hover is a texture rather than a lightening, the modal backdrop is a checker of the void, and 'unavailable' is a half-density dither laid over the thing itself. Depth is a hard offset shadow in the void, the way a sprite casts one. Selection is a full cell inversion — paper ground, space ink.

Product truth binds the world: no network fetch ever (fonts are bundled woff2), 'gaming wins' (no layout-property transitions, zero infinite animations), offline and reconnecting are normal states and are never alarm-colored, and the theme is fixed dark with color-scheme: dark.
keyCharacteristics: Sixteen locked colors; every other value is an alias into the table or a 2px ordered dither of two entries
Square everything: all radius tokens exist and are all zero
Blue title strips make each zone a titled window; the chrome is the composition
One bitmap face at one weight; hierarchy is size, color and inversion
Hard offset shadows, no blur; motion in steps(), never eased fades
One decorative signature: the dithered dusk horizon band

rules.name: The Sixteen-Color Lock
rules.body: Every color on screen is one of the sixteen --c-* values or an ordered 2px dither of exactly two of them. A color that is not — an rgba(), a blend, a seventeenth hue — is a bug, not a variation.

rules.name: The One Magenta Fill Rule
rules.body: Join the call is the only solid magenta fill in the resting window. Counts and badges are inverted paper cells; DND, LIVE and the pressed 'off' toggles use magenta only as small marks. A second magenta fill demotes the first.

rules.name: The Dither-Not-Blend Rule
rules.body: A mid-tone is repeating-conic-gradient(A 0% 25%, B 25% 50%) at 2px (4px when riding the band): hover is violet-on-indigo cells, the modal backdrop is space-on-window cells, primary-button hover flips a quarter of its cells to paper. No alpha, no gradient blends, no color-mix.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: There is no bold. font-weight: 400 everywhere, <b> elements are explicitly reset to 400 and speak through color. Emphasis is size, color, casing or inversion.

rules.name: The Two Tiers Rule
rules.body: Text is paper or silver — the old four-step grey ladder collapsed to two. A third grey is a bug.

rules.name: The Hard Offset Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is Xpx Xpx 0 in space — zero blur, and only on floating surfaces. A blurred or ambient shadow does not exist in this world.

dos: Do build every color from the sixteen --c-* tokens; a new mid-tone is an ordered 2px repeating-conic-gradient of exactly two of them.
Do make selection an inversion (paper ground, space ink) and re-invert anything that sits on an inverted row.
Do snap state changes with steps() (90-400ms) and keep every transition on compositor properties (transform, opacity); honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do give a new surface the window grammar: blue title strip, 1px space under-edge, violet/steel border, square corners, hard offset shadow only if it floats.
Do keep icons on the 24x24 stroke-2 square-cap miter grid, colored by currentColor; draw a missing glyph to these rules rather than substituting.
Do keep JetBrains Mono for code blocks and tabular figures — the one non-bitmap face, by concession.
donts: Don't use alpha, blur, gradient blends, or color-mix — no translucency exists in this world; dim by dithering (the modal backdrop is the model).
Don't add a second solid magenta fill to the resting window, and don't let magenta (DND, LIVE, primary) and coral (failure) trade jobs — they must never share a value.
Don't round a corner, blur a shadow, or synthesize a bold — all radii are 0, all shadows are hard offsets in space, and the face has one weight.
Don't run an infinite animation or transition a layout property — 'gaming wins' is a product invariant; the speaking frame appears, it never pulses.
Don't dither an absent peer's name — sprite and status word only; the name stays legible in a dark room.
Don't alarm-color offline or reconnecting: offline is an unlit steel square, connecting is amber, and neither is coral.
Don't derive values from design/main-window.html or design/shots/ — they document the replaced 2026-08-04 world and are anti-reference here.
Don't fetch a font or any asset from the network; faces ship as bundled woff2.
